name: Minimum binary radius-one covering code of length 10

source_review.definition: Binary length 10, radius 1; minimize distinct centers covering all 1024 words. Independent direct minimum Hamming distances differ from formal bitset union.
source_review.human: Hamming 1950 parity-check reconstruction gives 16*8=128 centers; syndrome argument covers every prefix and suffix. Historical Östergård 1991 reports 120 independently of the separate 2020 OEIS witness.
source_review.public: Frozen 120-word OEIS entry matches n=10 section only. No identity with 1991 code is assumed. AI provenance of public list not stated.
source_review.open_status: Current OEIS A000983 explicitly gives 107–120 for n=10; source tables and 2024 covering-code paper retain gap. Independently elementary sphere bound is only ceil(1024/11)=94, not a reproduction of published 107 proof.
source_review.isolation: Read initial, greedy baseline and evolution: no comparison assets or human/reference imports. Five strict runs, full-universe distance checks, full-return claim invariance, damaged samples, replay, cold export and failure controls passed.
